11.
No act or proceeding of the Commission shall be,
or be deemed to be, invalid by reason only of the existence
of  any  vacancy  among  its  members  or  any  defect  in  the
appointment of a member thereof.

12.
The  remuneration  of  the  Chairperson  and  other
members of the Commission shall be as may be determined
by the President.

13.
(1)  The  Chairperson  or  any  other  member  of  the
Commission  who,  whether  directly  or  indirectly,  has  any
interest in an authorised person, shall forthwith inform the
Director-General in writing of the nature and extent of such
